name: Rikka Beauty
desc:
If a card is Tributed: You can Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Rikka Beauty" once per turn.
(Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card you control; add 1 "Rikka" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, or Set 1 "Rikka" Spell/Trap directly from your Deck to your Spell & Trap Zone, and you can activate that card this turn. You can only use this effect of "Rikka Beauty" once per turn.
If this card is sent to the GY: You can add this card to your hand, then, if this card was Tributed this turn, Special Summon 1 "Rikka" monster from your Deck in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Rikka Beauty" once per turn.
strings: Special Summon this card from your hand in Defense Position?
Add 1 "Rikka" Spell/Trap from Deck to hand or Set it
Add this card to hand, then Special Summon 1 "Rikka" monster?
